featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s been almost three years at this gym, and here’s something no one really talks about.
Firstly, the fee structure is inconsistent. I was told ₹8,000 over the phone, but when I went to make the payment, I was charged ₹9,000. I chose to ignore it at the time because I genuinely valued my workouts more than the extra ₹1,000 — but transparency matters.
Secondly, the gym has a social media page where they post members’ pictures and videos. Initially, they posted a few of mine. However, one day I was told they don’t post selfies and only repost workout videos. I respected that decision. But the very next day, I noticed they had posted selfies of others — including someone posing at home, not even at the gym.
The only visible difference? They had opted for personal training.
It feels like visibility and support are selective unless you’re paying extra.
Lastly, even access to machines like the treadmill and elliptical sometimes feels subjective, depending on who is using them.
This is my final term here, and I won’t be renewing my membership.
